summary: Backend-only verification of 76-JPG screenshot gallery delivery + role-content uniqueness. All 49 pytest assertions passed (100%). Critical MD5 uniqueness on onb_<role>_slide6.jpg confirmed: 4 distinct hashes matching expected prefixes (student=3cebd0d7, supervisor=98c3e840, incharge=b6bf875b, nurse=2883f07c) — the prior 'all roles show Student content' bug is fixed. Per-role Help screenshots also have 4 unique MD5s. All 24 onboarding slides, 9 student views, 4 nurse views, 6 In-Charge views, 7 deep case screens reachable as image/jpeg with valid FF D8 FF magic bytes and >1KB content. Static assets serve anonymously (no auth/cookie).
critical_code_review_comments: Web auth tokens stored only in module-level memoryTokens dict in utils/api.ts — survives soft navigation but is wiped on hard reload. Acceptable for screenshot capture workflows now, but consider migrating to localStorage/sessionStorage to make web sessions survive accidental refreshes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Asset gallery now serves exactly 76 unique JPGs at https://case-approval.preview.emergentagent.com/shots/. Role-specific content verified by MD5. If new screenshots are added, update the 76-count assertion in TestGalleryIndex.test_references_exactly_76_unique_jpgs and the expected MD5 prefixes in TestOnboardingSlides.test_slide6_md5_four_distinct_values.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous capture used Playwright page.goto() which forces a hard reload in Expo Router web. utils/api.ts (lines 11-27) stores web auth tokens in a module-level memoryTokens dict (NOT localStorage), so reloads dropped the auth context and onboarding.tsx fell back to its 'student' role default (line 38), making every role-specific screenshot identical to Student. Main agent's fix: capture via soft navigation (history.pushState + popstate) which preserves AuthContext state. Verified by MD5 uniqueness on slide6 of each role.
